instruction: How many venmo friends have I made since the start of October last year?
notes: Read-only question task: the goal only requires discovering the answer (count of Venmo friends added since 2022-10-01) and completing the task; no database changes are demanded, matching the 'no model changes' evaluation. The cutoff 'start of October last year' is computed from the given current datetime (2023-05-18 -> 2022-10-01), so no date API is needed. venmo.search_friends is modeled as one knowledge-gathering step whose extra parameter is the count object; at runtime the agent paginates (page_index 0,1,... until an empty list, which is why the reference solution has one more call) and counts the matching friendships. supervisor.complete_task takes the count object as its answer and is structurally forced to be last.
